Metadata.title: Nemouw
Metadata.description: Find verified allied health specialists in Lebanon.

problems.type: This file type isn't accepted. Use {types}.
problems.size: This file is too large. The limit is {size}.

HomePage.tagline: Public site for patients and specialists.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

brand.headline: Let patients across Lebanon find you.
brand.description: Nemouw helps patients find verified speech, occupational and psychomotor therapists, special educators and other allied health specialists.

password.personal: Doesn't include “nemouw” or the part of your email before @

Auth.spamHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder.

Signup.metaDescription: Create your specialist account on Nemouw so patients across Lebanon can find your practice.
Signup.title: Create your specialist account
Signup.description: We'll email you a 6-digit code to confirm your email.

errors.emailTaken: An account already uses this email.
errors.codeAlreadySent: We sent a code to this email less than a minute ago. Check your inbox, or try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

Verify.title: Check your email
Verify.description: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
Verify.resent: We sent a new code to {email}.

errors.invalidCode: This code is wrong or has expired. Try again, or send a new code.

Password.title: Choose a password
Password.description: You'll use it with your email to log in to Nemouw.

errors.setupExpired: This step has expired. Confirm your email again to continue.

Login.title: Log in to Nemouw
Login.description: Welcome back. Use the email and password you signed up with.

errors.suspended: This account has been suspended. If you think this is a mistake, contact Nemouw support.
errors.notVerified: Confirm your email to finish creating your account.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter the email you signed up with. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sentDescription: If an account exists for {email}, we sent it a link to reset your password. The link expires in 60 minutes.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.description: You'll use it to log in to Nemouw from now on.
ResetPassword.doneDescription: Your new password is set. Log in to continue.

errors.invalidLink: This link has expired or was already used.

Onboarding.title: Set up your profile
Onboarding.description: Pick your public username and confirm your syndicate membership. You can fill in the rest of your profile next.

Membership.usernameHint: 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. It becomes your public profile link.
Membership.syndicatesEmpty: No syndicates are available yet. Contact Nemouw support.
Membership.memberNumberHint: Your membership number in this syndicate. We use it to verify your credentials.

errors.usernameFormat: Use only letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores
errors.usernameTaken: This username is taken. Try another.
errors.usernameUnavailable: This username isn't available. Try another.
errors.memberNumberTaken: This member number is already registered with this syndicate.
errors.syndicateLocked: Your syndicate verified your profile, so your syndicate can't change any more. Contact Nemouw support if it is wrong.

overview.title: Welcome back
overview.description: Signed in as @{username}. Here is where your profile stands.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Your syndicate hasn't verified your profile yet. Patients can find you once it's verified.

active.label: Verified
active.description: Your syndicate verified your profile on {date}. Patients can find you.

rejected.label: Not verified
rejected.description: Your syndicate couldn't verify your profile, so patients can't find you yet. Check your details and contact your syndicate.
rejected.descriptionWithReason: Your syndicate couldn't verify your profile: {reason}. Patients can't find you yet. Update your credentials, or contact your syndicate.

credentials.title: Add your credentials
credentials.description: Your degree or licence, so your syndicate can verify you. Patients find you once you're verified.

location.title: Add where and when you work
location.description: Your clinic's address and your opening hours, so patients know where to go and when.

photo.title: Add a profile picture
photo.description: A clear photo of you helps patients feel at ease before they get in touch.

details.title: Add your practice details
details.description: Years of experience, your main language and a WhatsApp number patients can reach.

about.title: Introduce yourself
about.description: A short bio, in at least one language, so patients know who you are.

conditions.title: Choose the conditions you treat
conditions.description: Patients search by condition, so this is how they find you.

Profile.title: Your profile
Profile.description: What patients see on your public page. Changes show as soon as you save.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Patients see these on your public page. They save as soon as you pick them.
photos.coverHint: A wide image across the top of your page. We crop it to 1600 × 600.

details.title: Practice details
details.description: Patients use these to choose a specialist and get in touch.
details.whatsappHint: Patients contact you on this number
details.phoneFormat: Enter a valid phone number for this country
details.languageHint: The language you work in most
details.ageHint: In years. Leave blank for no limit.
details.ageRange: Must be at least the youngest age

about.title: About you
about.description: Write your title, headline and bio in each language you want patients to read them in. Patients see the version in their language, or another one when it is missing.
about.formDescription: Shown to patients browsing Nemouw in {language}.
about.headline: Headline
about.headlineHint: One line that sums up your work
about.bioPlaceholder: Your training, the people you work with and how you work.

Credentials.title: Credentials
Credentials.description: Add your degrees, licences and memberships. Your syndicate reviews each one; once they verify you, patients can find you.

empty.title: No credentials yet
empty.description: Add your degree or licence to send it to your syndicate for review.

card.rejected: Your syndicate couldn't verify this credential. Edit it or replace its document to send it for review again.
card.rejectedBecause: Your syndicate couldn't verify this credential: {reason}. Edit it or replace its document to send it for review again.
card.viewFailed: We couldn't open the document. Try again.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this credential?
withdraw.description: “{title}” and its document will be deleted, and your syndicate will no longer review it.
withdraw.verifiedDescription: “{title}” is verified. Withdrawing it deletes it and its document; to show it again you'll have to submit it and wait for a new review.

form.description: Your syndicate checks these details against the document.
form.resubmitDescription: Saving sends this credential back to your syndicate for review.
form.title: Title
form.expiryHint: Leave empty if it doesn't expire
form.documentHint: A scan or photo of the original, or a PDF. Only you and your syndicate can see it.
form.dateOrder: Must be on or after the issue date

errors.verified: This credential was verified in the meantime, so it can't be changed. Withdraw it and add a new one instead.

Locations.title: Locations & hours
Locations.description: Where you see patients, and when. Your main location is the one patients see first.

empty.title: No locations yet
empty.description: Add the clinic or centre where you see patients, then its opening hours.

remove.title: Remove this location?
remove.description: “{place}” and its opening hours will be deleted.
remove.primary: This is your main location. Make another location main before removing it.
remove.primaryHint: To remove your main location, make another one main first.

hours.title: Opening hours at {place}
hours.description: Add a time range for each day you're open. Add more than one for a break in the day.

form.firstDescription: Your first location becomes your main one.
form.label: Name
form.labelHint: Optional. We show the city when there's no name.
form.phoneHint: The clinic's number, if patients can call it
form.phoneFormat: Enter a valid phone number for this country

Conditions.title: Conditions you treat
Conditions.description: Patients search by condition. Pick every condition you treat.
Conditions.empty: No conditions are listed on Nemouw yet. Check back soon.

form.title: Conditions
form.description: Your choices show on your public page.
form.selected: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Your public username and your syndicate membership.

username.title: Username
username.description: It becomes the link to your public page, so change it with care: old links stop working.

membership.title: Syndicate membership
membership.description: Your syndicate uses these to verify your credentials.
membership.locked: Locked: your syndicate has verified your profile.
